reconciliation_with_knowledge_operations.line_numbers: All 23 symbol ranges in companion/knowledge_operations_source_map.json match the baseline export (AST), and the 6 file sha256 values match the baseline inventory.
discrepancies: D-1 Baseline inventory dispositions: corpus_qa.py, repair_corpus.py, harvest_rsoxs.py and run.py are 'retain_baseline_seam', not 'retain_cli_facade_T19A_review'; the other 17 scripts/*.py are the latter. The 15 scripts/*.sh files, slurm_scripts/run_ollama.sh and scripts/.env.example are absent from f2w_baseline_inventory.json.

D-2 get_pdf_years: KNOWLEDGE_OPERATIONS says 'Preserve source/method and uncertainty', but guess_year returns only a year and scan_folder writes filename,year. Exposing provenance is new output (additive), not preservation.
D-3 get_pdf_years.scan_folder is non-recursive; the harvest layout papers/rsoxs/{year}/ is not covered. Not mentioned in the source map.
D-4 The corpus_qa histogram caveat is confirmed: 155 histogram increments against 4 distinct papers with a year on extracted_terms_xray_papers_cborg_chat.json.

D-5 Not in the source map: corpus_qa sections 3 and 5 encode measurement-vs-technique expectations (including non-schema classes) that conflict with D20 if presented as defects; on baseline data section 5 reports every paper as 'zero-measurement'.
D-6 Not in the source map: analyze_kgs silently skips gemini/cborg checkpoints and uses filename paper counts (147 vs 145).
D-7 Not in the source map: tiled_graph experiment-identity counts are capped at 800 per type without disclosure (OP07).

D-8 Not in the source map: repair_corpus emits non-schema categories and predicates (OP09); ingest_rsoxs_v3 writes nodes/edges-shaped KG (OP10); two scripts overwrite matkg_bl1101_v7.json (OP11/OP12).
D-9 The source map lists list_missing_rsoxs_papers as read-only diagnostics; its default output overwrites tracked repo-root missing_rsoxs_papers.txt.
D-10 summarize_extracted_terms does not call _eligible_pages; it has its own eligibility logic with a different rule for extraction_state=full.
D-11 The proposed scripts/ facade list in KNOWLEDGE_OPERATIONS section 2 omits repair_corpus.py (CLI-only here) and corpus_qa's dependency on typer.
